name: The Hive Gallery
about_text: The Hive Gallery and Studios is a gallery and working-artist complex on Los Angeles' Downtown Art Walk, founded in Spring 2005 by Nathan Cartwright. It combines two exhibition galleries with about 25 working artist studios and an artist-made goods store. The program centers on neo-pop illustration and craft-driven, affordable work, with monthly opening shows featuring five spotlighted artists alongside large group exhibitions, live painting, and performance. Operating on low or no commission, the gallery emphasizes accessibility for new collectors while also offering higher-priced work from established artists. Beyond sales, it functions as a community hub hosting yoga, figure drawing, film screenings, and fundraising events, positioning itself as a long-running fixture of the Downtown LA art scene.

triage.site_notes: Site is a WordPress-style blog with two long chronological archives (/exhibitions/... one page per monthly show since 2005, and /news/... one post per announcement) but no dedicated roster/artist-index or current-exhibitions landing page distinct from the general category listing; many exhibition pages double as artist listings since no separate roster exists.
